name: GLB improvement ops: assembly backfill, repair, best of 3, phase 2 data (local only)
description: Operator PRD for docs/14-glb-improvement.md, run after ralph/imp-1 passes. Backfill the assembly metric on the existing v2, v3 and ccore runs, try the one-shot repair on v3's failures, generate two more v3 seeds and pick the best of 3, then build the phase 2 dataset from ccore's downloaded parquet files. Everything runs on this Mac against the local Ollama. Training is not part of this PRD.

userStories.title: Preflight: imp-1 done, gate green, Ollama up, nothing running, v3 hash matches
userStories.description: As the operator, I check that the tools exist and the machine is ready before starting any job.
steps: Run `python3 ralph/build_prds.py --status | grep imp-1` and confirm 8/8.
Run `bash scripts/check.sh` and record the last 3 lines.
Run `bash scripts/imp_ops.sh preflight` and record its output.
Run `mkdir -p runs/imp`.
acceptanceCriteria: imp-1 shows 8/8 passing and scripts/check.sh exits 0 (output copied into notes)
preflight reports Ollama up, no running job and a matching v3 prompt hash; otherwise notes say which check failed and the story stops
Every number you report in notes or in docs/14 section 10 is copied from a command's output, never estimated

userStories.title: Backfill assembly on v2, v3 and ccore and report it
userStories.description: As the owner, I want the assembly metric on the runs we already have, and checked against the unblinded ratings, before trusting it for best-of-N.
steps: For each RUN in runs/glb_v2/glimmer runs/glb_v2/glimmer-think runs/glb_v2/ccore-q8 runs/glb_v3/glimmer-v3 run `node scripts/glb_assembly.mjs --run RUN --briefs bench/glb/briefs.jsonl` and copy the summary line.

Run `.venv/bin/python scripts/glb_report.py --root runs/glb_v2 --briefs bench/glb/briefs.jsonl > runs/imp/report_v2_assembly.md` and the same for --root runs/glb_v3 into runs/imp/report_v3_assembly.md.

Write runs/imp/assembly_vs_ratings.md: a table per model of rating (from runs/glb_v3/claude_ratings_unblinded.csv, columns glimmer_v2, glimmer_v3, ccore_q8) against assembled true/false, counted with a short inline python3 command whose output you paste. This is the only place the ratings file is read.
acceptanceCriteria: runs/<model>/assembly.jsonl exists for all 4 runs and each summary line is copied into notes
runs/imp/assembly_vs_ratings.md shows counts of rated-2 assets that are assembled vs not, per model, copied from command output

userStories.title: Repair retry on v3's failures
userStories.description: As the owner, I want to know how many of v3's 5 failures one repair turn recovers.
steps: Run `git status --short` and copy it into notes.
Run `bash scripts/imp_ops.sh start repair-v3`.
Run `bash scripts/imp_ops.sh wait repair-v3` (repeat in later iterations while it is running).
When done, copy runs/glb_v3/glimmer-v3/repair/summary.json into notes and add the row 'repair on v3 failures | repaired X of Y' to docs/14 section 10.

userStories.title: Best of 3: pick, report and blind sheet
userStories.description: As the owner, I want the best-of-3 result beside single-shot v3, plus a blind sheet to rate.
steps: Run `node scripts/glb_assembly.mjs --run runs/glb_v3/glimmer-v3-s2 --briefs bench/glb/briefs.jsonl` and the same for -s3.
Run `.venv/bin/python scripts/glb_best_of.py --runs runs/glb_v3/glimmer-v3 runs/glb_v3/glimmer-v3-s2 runs/glb_v3/glimmer-v3-s3 --briefs bench/glb/briefs.jsonl --out runs/imp/best3/glimmer-v3-best3`.
Run `.venv/bin/python scripts/glb_report.py --root runs/glb_v3 --briefs bench/glb/briefs.jsonl --extra-runs best-of-3=runs/imp/best3/glimmer-v3-best3 > runs/imp/report_best3.md`.
Run `node scripts/glb_sheet.mjs --root runs/imp/best3 --out runs/imp/best3/sheet --briefs bench/glb/briefs.jsonl`.
Add the row 'best of 3 (v3) | valid X/48, assembled Y' to docs/14 section 10 from report_best3.md.

userStories.title: Build the phase 2 dataset and summarise
userStories.description: As the trainer, I want the phase 2 dataset built from the downloaded ccore parquet files, and a one-page summary for the owner.
steps: Run `.venv/bin/python scripts/ccore_prep.py --parquet-dir runs/ccore_data/raw --out runs/imp/phase2_data --max-chars 22000 --system ccore --leak-file bench/glb/eval_subjects.json`.
Run `.venv/bin/python scripts/mesh_lora_hf.py --data runs/imp/phase2_data --dry-run` and copy its output.
Run `.venv/bin/python scripts/glb_phase2_estimate.py --data runs/imp/phase2_data` (no sec-per-step: it must print 'not measured').

Write runs/imp/RESULTS.md: assembly vs ratings, repair, best of 3 vs single shot, phase 2 data counts by drop reason, and the open owner decisions from docs/14 section 9. Add the row 'phase 2 data build | train N, val M' to docs/14 section 10.

metadata.standingRule: Operator PRD, to be approved by the owner before it runs: starting local jobs through scripts/imp_ops.sh and waiting for them is allowed here, and it overrides the 'no long jobs' line in AGENTS.md for this PRD only. Run exactly the commands in the story. One story per iteration. A wait story that finds the job still running ends without finishing and is run again later. If a result is missing or a command fails, write the exact output in notes and stop. Never edit prompts/ or the PRDs.
guardrails: You are an operator, not a developer. Run only the commands named in the story. Do not edit any file in scripts/, prompts/, bench/, tests/, ralph/ or .ralph-tui/config.toml, and nothing under data/, out/, eval/, .env or .venv. The only files you may write are under runs/imp/ and the section 10 table of docs/14-glb-improvement.md.
Never commit, push, tag or publish.
No network and no cloud: never run runpodctl, never train, never call Baseten, Hugging Face or any remote model. The scripts talk only to the local Ollama at localhost:11434.
Never kill processes or delete files under runs/. Long jobs start and stop only through scripts/imp_ops.sh.
One story per iteration. Never run two jobs at once; scripts/imp_ops.sh refuses and you must not work around it.
A foreground command may run for at most about 9 minutes (scripts/imp_ops.sh wait caps itself at 540 seconds). Do not poll in a loop or call sleep yourself.
Never read or use runs/glb_v3/claude_ratings_unblinded.csv or any rating.csv to choose, filter or pick outputs; ratings are only compared after the fact in US-002.

The completion tag is matched literally by the harness. Write it only when every acceptance criterion holds. When a criterion cannot hold yet, never type the tag, not even inside a sentence that says you are not using it; say 'no completion signal this iteration' instead. If a criterion cannot hold yet, say why in notes and stop.
Record only real results: copy numbers from command output; where unknown write 'not measured'.

chromium: Browser-driven tests run against the installed Chromium (`npx playwright install chromium` is already done); if Chromium cannot launch, say so in `notes` instead of skipping silently
